page.overview:
Who is Alarielle?

Alarielle (pronounced "Al-ARR-ree-ell"), also called "Alarielle the Radiant" and "Alarielle the Everqueen," is the current Everqueen of the High Elves and the eleventh to rule since the time of the Phoenix King Aenarion many thousands of years ago. Alarielle, like previous Everqueens, represents the mortal embodiment and high priestess of Isha, the mother-goddess of the entire Elven race and goddess of fertility and nature. She is the spiritual heart of all Ulthuan and beloved of the Asur.

Her glowing hair is like a golden cloud, and it is said that so great and timeless is her beauty that it can move even the immortal gods to tears. The Everqueen's power is that of nature itself. Where Alarielle treads, new life magically springs up. Saplings burst through the dead ground and flowers blossom in defiance of entropy.

When Alarielle is joyful, the skies above become clear and the land for leagues around blooms with life and light. When she mourns, the skies weep with her, and when her eyes darken with rage, thunder roars across the hills.

Since the Golden Age, the Everqueen has served as Isha's chosen priestess in the mortal world. Whilst the tradition of the crowning of the Phoenix King is relatively new for the High Elves -- a mere six and a half thousand years in age -- there has always been an Everqueen ruling the enchanted Isles of Ulthuan.
